mechanism: Diltiazem inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing haloperidol plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity; both drugs prolong QT interval and have negative inotropic effects.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; consider haloperidol dose reduction; assess for extrapyramidal symptoms and cardiac arrhythmias; use alternative antipsychotic if possible.
